label: Lucius - System Test
info:
Manual diagnostic flow — click the inject node to run. Checks, in order: (1) the secrets config file loads and has every required key populated, (2) generic internet reachability, (3) InfluxDB reachability, (4) Oura's API reachability, (5) GoDaddy's api/status.php reachability + auth + version-sync. Results print to the debug sidebar as one summary. Does NOT run on a schedule — this is a manual health check, not a monitoring job.

UNTESTED, same caveat as the other two flows — built carefully but never run against a live stack. See homeassistant/README.md.

name: 1b. Parse config, start test
2. Record web + prepare InfluxDB check
3. Record InfluxDB + prepare Oura check
4. Record Oura + prepare GoDaddy check
5. Record GoDaddy + build summary
